title: Next.js
blurb: Routing, rendering modes (SSG/SSR/ISR/RSC), data fetching and deployment.

quiz.question: In the App Router, components inside app/ are by default…
quiz.explanation: Everything in app/ is a Server Component unless the file (or an importer) starts with 'use client'.

quiz.question: What is a Server Action?
options: An async server function (marked 'use server') that forms or client code can call directly to mutate data
quiz.explanation: Server Actions run on the server and can be passed to <form action>; validate input and check authorization inside them, because they're publicly reachable endpoints.

quiz.question: Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) means…
options: Static pages are regenerated in the background after a revalidate interval or on-demand revalidation
Pages are rendered only in the browser
The site is rebuilt on every commit
quiz.explanation: ISR serves the cached static page and regenerates it after the revalidate period (or when revalidatePath/revalidateTag is called), giving static speed with fresh data.

quiz.question: Where should a secret API key used to call a third-party API live in a Next.js app?
options: In server-only code (Server Components, Route Handlers, Server Actions) via a non-public env var
quiz.explanation: Variables prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC_ are inlined into the client bundle. Keep secrets in non-prefixed env vars read only on the server; the server-only package can enforce the boundary.

quiz.question: What does loading.tsx in a route segment do?
options: Wraps the segment in a Suspense boundary and shows its UI while the segment streams in
quiz.explanation: loading.tsx gives instant loading UI using React Suspense and streaming; not-found.tsx and error.tsx handle 404s and errors.

problems.title: Pick the rendering strategy
problems.prompt: Choose rendering for: (a) a marketing page, (b) a product page whose price changes hourly, (c) a logged-in dashboard.
problems.solution: (a) Fully static (prerendered at build). (b) Static with time-based revalidation (e.g., revalidate: 3600) or on-demand revalidateTag when prices change. (c) Dynamic per-request rendering (it reads cookies/session), streaming slow parts with Suspense; never cache per-user data in a shared cache.

problems.title: Secure a Server Action
problems.prompt: A Server Action deleteProject(id) is called from a button in a Client Component. What must it check?
problems.solution: Treat it as a public endpoint: authenticate the session inside the action, verify the user owns or may delete project id (authorization), validate the input (e.g., with Zod), then revalidate affected paths/tags. Hiding the button in the UI is not access control.
